summary: Master social media marketing with our comprehensive training course. Gain strategic insights to enhance your online presence and achieve your business goals.
lede: Social media marketing strategy connects channel goals, audience insight, content planning, and measurement in a coordinated approach. This training is for professionals who plan, publish, measure, or approve social activity and need to create campaign plans and report results. You’ll practice using the RACE Framework and SMART objectives, mapping audiences, building editorial calendars and campaign briefs, and interpreting platform analytics; the syllabus also covers community workflows, paid social planning, and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, publish, measure, or approve social media activity and need stronger structure, better reporting, and tighter campaign alignment.
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with social media platforms, basic marketing concepts, and common reporting metrics such as reach, engagement rate, clicks, and conversions. No coding is required, and prior use of a social media management platform is helpful but not mandatory. If you already manage content calendars, ad budgets, or brand channels, you will be able to apply the exercises directly to your current work.
